title: Recalculation clears changed-price acknowledgement
problem: A customer can bypass the dedicated changed-price acceptance after a stale quote rejection.
expected: The old/new affected prices stay disclosed and the exact fresh quote needs explicit acknowledgement before placement.
actual: React/jsdom probe: reject old quote, auto-requote, click Calculate total, tick terms, submit; no Accept new total click occurred. Native equivalent is code-supported.
solution: Bind price-change consent to quote ID/version and retain the old/new comparison across recalculation; invalidate all prior consent when terms or amounts change. Do not silently retry placement.
test: Run the committed diagnostic; preserve the probe; copy inverse expectations into application tests after repair and add repeated change, mode/address/quantity edits, refresh failure and accepted-order recovery cases.
acceptance: No order POST until explicit consent to the current changed quote; committed order snapshots and same-key recovery remain unchanged.

title: Known allergens cannot be declared in meal creation
screen_persona: Cook meal creation; customers with allergies
problem: The form defaults to NONE_DECLARED and offers only none/unknown.
expected: Cook deliberately selects unknown/none/contains and can name known allergens and explanatory text.
actual: Meals.tsx:164,203–213,247–252 cannot submit CONTAINS/codes/note although MealController supports them. No real misdeclaration is claimed.
solution: Use a neutral required declaration, localized supported-code choices and statement; retain publication guards.
test: Create unknown/none/contains fixtures, reject missing contains codes; reopen/edit and inspect customer web/native response.
acceptance: All three truthful declaration states can be authored; no default claim of absence; kitchen statements reach both clients.

title: Native meal omits understandable allergen information
screen_persona: Native Meal; Arabic customers with allergies
problem: Raw enum values replace localized allergen names and the kitchen statement is omitted.
expected: Read the same meaningful allergy information available on web before adding food.
actual: Native Meal.tsx:83–87 joins allergenCodes and omits allergenStatement; web Meal.tsx maps names and renders the note.
solution: Reuse localized allergen keys and include statement with unknown/none/contains distinctions; no dietary safety guarantees.
test: Render each declaration plus a long Arabic statement; exercise TalkBack/VoiceOver and large text on actual native targets.
acceptance: No raw known enum appears; note retained; accessible reading order precedes purchase controls.

title: Kitchen onboarding ends without an action
problem: The existing onboarding screen has no application editor or start/submit action.
expected: Start/save/submit a draft and respond to requested changes with clear public/private fields.
actual: Fixture-backed browser rendered no-application message with zero interactive controls in main; source Onboarding.tsx only GETs and prints state. Backend workflow exists.
solution: Build the bounded application/revision form on existing contracts and private upload flow; document policy-dependent required documents.
test: Applicant draft→submit→changes requested→resubmit; keyboard and narrow-screen upload/error recovery; privacy checks.
acceptance: Application can progress without SQL/operator impersonation; errors preserve draft; review reasons localized; private documents never public.

title: Idle cook queues do not refresh incoming orders
problem: Orders arriving after mount are not fetched until a user action/remount.
expected: See new pending orders and accurate deadlines while the workspace remains open.
actual: Orders.tsx and Dashboard.tsx load via useServer keyed to filters/mutations, with no periodic/foreground refresh; dashboard link opens generic queue.
solution: Add bounded visible-page polling plus foreground refresh, last-updated/error status and direct focus on the selected order. Preserve server clock and state guards.
test: Open empty queue, create a synthetic order elsewhere, wait configured refresh bound, foreground after pause, race acceptance/expiry.
acceptance: Incoming order appears within declared bound without manual navigation; focus not stolen; stale/failed refresh visible; no timer extension.

title: Later result pages are unreachable
screen_persona: Discovery/kitchen comparison and affected lists; customers/cooks
problem: Clients request fixed first pages without next-cursor controls, hiding older or additional data.
expected: Reach all eligible results and understand whether more exist.
actual: Browser synthetic response has hasMore=true and nextCursor, but no next/load-more action or cursor request. Source extends concern to native discovery and multiple queues; those extensions remain code-supported.
solution: Consume bounded cursor pages with explicit loading/retry/end status; reset on filter change. Do not present kitchens derived from one meal page as complete discovery.
test: Seed more than each endpoint page limit; retrieve last item; change filters during slow pagination; handle empty/failed next page.
acceptance: Every hasMore page reachable; no duplicates/omissions; stale cursor discarded; counts labelled as loaded vs total.

title: Active commerce configuration has not reconciled free-launch direction
problem: Latest owner zero-commission launch direction diverges from commission-capable active policy, fixtures and wording.
expected: All Matbakhy platform charges remain zero/inactive at launch; external costs distinct.
actual: Active implementation retains commission calculations/statement fields and synthetic 10% examples; latest main explicitly requires zero across server/ledger/UI. No production fee or charge was observed.
solution: Reconcile authority into existing stories and server/ledger launch configuration, fixtures and labels; essential earnings free; keep future paid growth gated off.
test: Launch quote→fulfilled order→statement/refund: platform charge/commission zero in each layer; try unauthorized paid activation.
acceptance: No hidden fees/paid rank/billing; no misleading profit label; placed snapshots untouched; future activation requires owner authorization.

title: Approved direct-deposit journey is not integrated
problem: Cash-first clients/contracts do not express latest approved manual direct-to-kitchen deposit flow.
expected: See total/deposit/remainder/recipient/expiry and honest receipt-report status with recovery.
actual: Latest main strategy and sequence approve manual deposit product scope; active Checkout/Cart/order state contract remains cash-first. This is incomplete approved scope, not a failed live payment.
solution: First reconcile state/contract stories; deliver synthetic vertical slices. Separate customer transfer report, kitchen receipt report and acceptance; never claim bank verification or request automatic duplicate transfer.
test: COD plus deposit fixtures: mismatch/false proof/expiry/delayed transfer/cancellation/kitchen rejection/manual refund; prep gate and concurrency.
acceptance: Preparation blocked until receipt acknowledged AND order accepted; price immutable after placement; remaining amount exact; uncertainty has reconciliation path; live-money gates remain blocked.

title: Policy acceptance has no readable policy destination
problem: Terms checkbox has plain text while web/native routers provide no terms/privacy/help document screen.
expected: Read the exact policies before accepting and return without losing basket.
actual: Checkout.tsx:386–388; native Cart choice; App route dispatcher and native navigation have no policy route. Approved legal text availability is unverified.
solution: Expose versioned policy content adjacent to consent with readable Arabic; clearly draft in local environments and gate release on approved copy.
test: Open/read/return with keyboard and native screen reader; change policy version after acceptance and retry.
acceptance: Accepted version matches readable content; changed version resets consent; draft never presented as approved legal policy.

title: Order again only opens the first dish
problem: Reorder shortcut drops all other prior lines and quantities.
expected: Review the whole previous basket using current availability/prices.
actual: Web Orders.tsx:124 and native Orders.tsx:196/238 navigate to items[0].mealId.
solution: Build a current multi-line reorder review with unavailable-line explanation and common slot; until then name first-dish shortcut accurately.
test: Three-line historic order with changed price, archived line and existing conflicting basket.
acceptance: Available quantities retained for review; unavailable items named, no silent substitutions; replacement consent and fresh quote mandatory.

title: Navigation loses search and working context
problem: Returning from meal detail resets discovery query; operations selection also lives only in memory.
expected: Back/reload/share should recover meaningful permitted working context.
actual: Browser search→meal→in-page Back resets text and sends default query. Operations tab/reload behavior is code-supported.
solution: Serialize allowlisted filter/sort/cursor/tab/object state in existing navigation and restore scroll where useful; recheck access.
test: Filter→detail→Back/browser back/reload; ops select order→copy link/reload; invalid and forbidden state.
acceptance: Supported filters/locale persist; permitted object opens; no cross-role leakage; approved layout unchanged.

title: Native discovery lacks supported decision information
screen_persona: Native Discover/Meal; first-time and comparing customers
problem: Only text search/newest available; missing supported zone/category/price/sort and kitchen/photo/portion/slot detail.
expected: Find serviceable meals and compare genuine information on native as on web.
actual: Discover.tsx:18,57–70 and navigation lack filter/kitchen screen; Meal presentation omits photo/reviews.
solution: Reuse current API capability and approved hierarchy, with native filter/kitchen navigation; keep person-count filters D11-deferred.
test: Same supported query web/native yields equivalent eligible results; large-text/manual-zone/permission-denied flows.
acceptance: Native displays real portion/photo/next-slot where available, reachable kitchen context and supported filters; no invented catering or serving-person feature.

title: Kitchen cannot maintain general meal or slot content
problem: Creation/state/price actions exist but general content and existing capacity editing are absent.
expected: Correct meals and future capacity without recreating objects.
actual: Meals.tsx:36–71 and Slots.tsx:45–77 have no general editor; existing PATCH contracts support bounded updates.
solution: Expose existing edit contracts with expectedVersion, dirty-state protection and obligation explanation; preserve price history and order snapshots.
test: Edit ingredient/portion/photo, change capacity above and below obligations, simulate concurrent editor.
acceptance: Valid edit persists; conflict preserves input; below-obligation edit rejected with useful reason; history immutable.

title: Field-level server validation is discarded
problem: Shared mutation handlers reduce typed fieldErrors to a generic message.
expected: Identify and correct the exact failed field with preserved input.
actual: Customer shared.tsx:92–94 and operations equivalent ignore fieldErrors; forms largely lack error association.
solution: Retain typed errors, map localized messages, associate aria-describedby/invalid, focus summary or first invalid field; avoid universal form-framework rewrite.
test: 422 with two fields, server conflict and network retry; keyboard/screen-reader focus and preserved values.
acceptance: Each invalid field named and associated; no valid input lost; generic fallback remains for unknown errors.

title: Arabic numeric input is rejected or erased
problem: Arabic and Persian digits are not normalized before ASCII-only parsing/sanitization.
expected: Enter familiar digits without losing intended number or verification code.
actual: Browser maximum price ١٢٠ disables submit; source egpToMinor rejects localized digits and OTP replace(/\D/g,"") removes them. OTP extent is code-supported.
solution: Normalize Arabic/Persian decimal digits and supported decimal separator at boundary, then apply existing integer-money bounds; keep opaque IDs unchanged.
test: ASCII/Arabic/Persian budget and pasted OTP; invalid punctuation, huge number, negative and mixed input cases.
acceptance: Equivalent inputs produce same minor units/code; invalid values explained; no float-based money or weakened OTP validation.

title: Finance requires a kitchen UUID
problem: User must know an internal identifier before viewing a statement.
expected: Select a permitted named kitchen or follow an order/kitchen context link.
actual: Finance.tsx:6–25 validates raw UUID entry with no kitchen search/lookup.
solution: Add permission-scoped named kitchen selector and context links; retain opaque ID internally and server authorization.
test: Select similarly named kitchens with distinct stable labels; forbidden kitchen and network failure; keyboard selection.
acceptance: Operator can open intended statement without copying UUID; labels disambiguate; unauthorized data stays unavailable.

title: Native controls use low-contrast decorative borders
problem: Essential controls use decorative border token against their surfaces.
expected: Control boundaries remain distinguishable at WCAG non-text contrast target.
actual: ui.tsx:173/179/183; computed token border/surface ratio 1.702:1 (<3:1). Pixel/device result remains unverified.
solution: Use existing borderStrong for essential boundaries; preserve selected/focus text and state, verify actual composited native rendering.
test: Measure actual native normal/focus/selected input and choices against adjacent colors with large text.
acceptance: Essential boundaries reach 3:1 or an adequate alternative visible boundary; text contrast and touch targets retained.

title: Order status omits useful deadline/reason/support context
screen_persona: Order detail; waiting or rejected customer
problem: State timeline lacks acceptBy and event reason; new web support requires a detour through Account.
expected: Know what happens next, by when, why an exception occurred and how to get order-linked help.
actual: Web Orders.tsx:45–85 and native Orders.tsx:114–158; support links only existing cases; Account selects first-page orders.
solution: Show localized real deadline/reason/next action and create-case entry prefilled with current order. Keep payment/fulfillment separate and private notes excluded.
test: Pending/expired/rejected/delivery-failed fixtures, stale notification and foreign order; accessible help path.
acceptance: No invented ETA/GPS; pending distinguished from accepted; explanation and help reachable on relevant order.

title: Pending sign-out dialog does not manage focus
problem: Alertdialog renders after the active header control without intentional focus/return handling.
expected: Discover the warning and safely choose recovery, stay or leave using keyboard.
actual: App.tsx:157–177 alertdialog has no focus ref/effect; contrast with meal replacement managed focus.
solution: Apply existing dialog focus pattern; safest action first, sensible Escape and restoration; preserve pending keys when staying or sign-out fails.
test: With pending request keyboard-activate sign-out, inspect announced focus, cancel/escape/leave and failed logout.
acceptance: Warning immediately reachable/announced; no accidental placement/sign-out; focus returns predictably; pending recovery unchanged.

title: Unknown customer routes render an empty main area
screen_persona: Unknown hash route; customer following old link
problem: Unmatched route has no explanation or recovery link in main.
expected: Understand link is unavailable and navigate safely to browsing/orders.
actual: Browser #/missing-audit-route produces empty main; App only enumerates known matches.
solution: Add localized not-found state with safe Browse/Orders destinations and focusable heading; do not expose object existence.
test: Malformed route, retired link, valid route, forbidden order and refresh.
acceptance: Unknown route explains recovery; known routes unaffected; object authorization behavior retained.

title: Narrow financial summaries break monetary tokens
problem: Long labels and summary grid can squeeze currency amounts into vertical fragments.
expected: Read an intact amount/currency and map each value to the right label.
actual: Current Chromium synthetic-statement probe reproduced split monetary digits in cook AR320, EN320 and EN390; desktop1440 and AR390 intact for this fixture. Existing MBQA-006 documents additional historical finance variants; those were not rerun here.
solution: Reuse historical MBQA-006; stack summary rows at narrow width or reserve min-content monetary width; preserve semantic table/scroll region and bidi isolation.
test: Repeat cook/finance ×320/390/1440×AR/EN with decimals, long labels and keyboard scroll.
acceptance: Digits/decimal token stay intact; no label-value ambiguity; no horizontal page overflow; exact API values preserved.
